prompt.zh-CN: 把《狼来了》做成约三分钟的电影感手绘动画短片，中英文各一版。用“回声就是信任”串起三次喊狼：第一声传遍山谷，第二声变弱，第三声真有狼却没有回应。多角色配音、原创配乐与声波动效，先播放预览。
prompt.en: Create a roughly three-minute cinematic, hand-painted animated retelling of The Boy Who Cried Wolf in Chinese and English. Make echoes stand for trust: the first cry reaches the whole valley, the second grows weaker, and the real third cry gets no answer. Use multiple character voices, original music and animated sound waves. Show the preview first.
prompt.zh-Hant: 把《狼來了》做成約三分鐘的電影感手繪動畫短片，中英文各一版。用「回聲就是信任」串起三次喊狼：第一聲傳遍山谷，第二聲變弱，第三聲真有狼卻沒有回應。多角色配音、原創配樂與聲波動效，先播放預覽。
prompt.ja: 「オオカミ少年」を約3分の映画風手描きアニメにし、中国語版と英語版を作って。こだまを信頼の象徴にして、最初の叫びは谷全体へ、二度目は弱く、本当に狼が来た三度目には返事がない。複数の声とオリジナル音楽、音波の動きを使い、先にプレビューを見せて。
prompt.ko: 양치기 소년을 약 3분 길이의 영화 같은 손그림 애니메이션으로 중국어와 영어 두 버전으로 만들어 줘. 메아리를 신뢰로 표현해 첫 외침은 골짜기에 가득하고 두 번째는 약해지며 진짜 늑대가 온 세 번째에는 응답이 없게 해. 여러 배역 목소리와 창작 음악, 음파 효과를 쓰고 먼저 미리보기를 보여 줘.
prompt.es: Crea una animación cinematográfica dibujada a mano de unos tres minutos de El pastor mentiroso, en chino e inglés. Usa el eco como símbolo de confianza: la primera llamada llena el valle, la segunda es débil y la tercera, real, queda sin respuesta. Incluye varias voces, música original y ondas animadas. Muestra primero la vista previa.
prompt.de: Erstelle eine etwa dreiminütige, filmisch handgezeichnete Animation von Der Hirtenjunge und der Wolf auf Chinesisch und Englisch. Das Echo steht für Vertrauen: Der erste Ruf füllt das Tal, der zweite wird schwächer, der echte dritte bleibt unbeantwortet. Nutze mehrere Stimmen, eigene Musik und animierte Schallwellen. Zeige zuerst eine Vorschau.
prompt.fr: Crée une animation cinématographique dessinée à la main, environ trois minutes, du Garçon qui criait au loup en chinois et en anglais. Les échos symbolisent la confiance : le premier appel remplit la vallée, le deuxième faiblit, le troisième, réel, reste sans réponse. Ajoute plusieurs voix, une musique originale et des ondes animées. Montre d’abord l’aperçu.
prompt.pt-BR: Crie uma animação cinematográfica desenhada à mão de cerca de três minutos de O menino que gritava lobo, em chinês e inglês. Faça os ecos representarem confiança: o primeiro grito enche o vale, o segundo enfraquece e o terceiro, verdadeiro, fica sem resposta. Use várias vozes, música original e ondas animadas. Mostre a prévia primeiro.

zh-CN.when: 题目很短、需要故事体验时
zh-CN.request: 首版原话：狼来了的故事。后续重做另明确要求付费配音。
zh-CN.problem: 当天六幕首版主要复述故事、共用山坡构图，编译与抽帧后交付，未确认连续播放；用户认为质量差。
zh-CN.change: 重做以“回声就是信任”贯穿15幕，角色反应、景别、声音逐步改变，并多轮修订。
zh-CN.principle: 先确定观众体验，让关键变化发生在画面和声音里，内部第一稿不等于可交首版。
zh-CN.cost: 重做增加素材、声音和检查投入；两版时长、预算、指令不同，不能证明某模型或流程更快。
zh-CN.counterexample: 不强制倒叙、声波、多角色或生成视频；清晰的纯代码或静态绘本也可成立。
zh-CN.verification: 原话、源码和局部帧支持方法差异，用户认可重做方向；尚非同条件盲评，编译通过不等于完整视听验收。

zh-CN.when: 带既有视频素材的样片封装遇到体积或媒体来源限制时
zh-CN.request: 制作目标：保留三段既有动作镜头；此处为目标摘要，不是用户逐字原话。
zh-CN.problem: 三段视频一起内联触发单幕8MB上限；data:video被既有CSP拒绝。
zh-CN.change: 按实际内容拆分三次呼喊幕，以现有允许的Blob来源播放；保留动态，不修改宿主CSP。
zh-CN.principle: 修复兼容问题时保留选定表现，具体修法受当前运行时约束。
zh-CN.cost: 随包素材压为960宽24fps，仍需检查观感；不能称为与原1080p/30同规格的提效。
zh-CN.counterexample: 不把Blob或分幕当所有工程规定；不能静默换静图，亦不为单片放宽安全规则。
zh-CN.verification: 中英副本runtimeErrors=0，三段动态与关键帧已核对；整片正常速度播放及人耳试听未验。

zh-CN.when: 为多角色故事片安排新配音时
zh-CN.request: 当前复刻建议，非当时原话：保留声音品质并按实际授权使用配音。
zh-CN.problem: 种子只是已有录音；无可用同音色来源时，改句不能靠种子生成，混换声音也会破坏一致性。
zh-CN.change: 普通旁白一个主音色；角色片按角色固定，多语言版保持角色与语种一致，先一句试听再按句缓存。
zh-CN.principle: 系统语音（macOS say / System voice）许可仅限个人非商业，只作草稿试听，不默认、不交付。依次查原声种子、已配置兼容服务或 Agent 的 Gemini TTS/ElevenLabs、本机神经语音；直装版 Qwen/Kokoro 另装，商店无 Qwen。全无则字幕与有许可配乐，告知改善方式，不回系统。完整策略见 galanty://guide/craft、galanty://environment。
zh-CN.cost: 先给免费可用方案；云端会收到旁白，先估费并获用户同意，沿用已有授权。空预算不授权收费，编译免费不代表云端免费。
zh-CN.counterexample: 用户可选不同表现；选了声音后不能擅自混音色，系统试听不构成交付授权。
zh-CN.verification: 当前选声建议；保留本片历史工具与费用记录，本次未新增合成或完整试听，不把历史验收当新句验收。

en.when: A short prompt calls for a story experience.
en.request: Original request: 狼来了的故事 (the story of the boy who cried wolf). A later remake separately requested paid voices.
en.problem: The day's six-scene draft largely retold the story in one hillside composition; compilation and stills did not establish continuous playback. The user rejected its quality.
en.change: The remake used an echo-as-trust idea across 15 scenes, changing reactions, framing and sound through several revisions.
en.principle: Design the viewer's experience and express key changes through picture and sound before calling an internal draft a first delivery.
en.cost: The remake used more assets, sound and review; unequal duration, budget and instructions do not establish model or workflow efficiency.
en.counterexample: Flashbacks, sound rings, multiple voices and generated video are optional. Code animation or a still-picture story can work well.
en.verification: Requests, source and selected frames establish differences in method; the user preferred the remake. This was not a controlled blind comparison or complete audiovisual sign-off.

en.when: Packaging existing video assets hits size or media-source limits.
en.request: Production goal summary, not a verbatim user quote: retain all three existing action shots.
en.problem: Inlining all shots exceeded the 8MB scene limit; data:video was rejected by the existing CSP.
en.change: Split the three cries by their actual content and use already-permitted Blob media sources without changing host CSP.
en.principle: Preserve the chosen effect while fixing the specific compatibility problem.
en.cost: Packaged clips became 960px/24fps; appearance still needs review and this is not an equal-spec efficiency improvement over 1080p/30.
en.counterexample: Do not require Blob or scene splitting for every project, silently replace motion with stills, or weaken security for one work.
en.verification: Both language copies had zero runtime errors and selected frames were checked; full normal-speed viewing and human listening remain unverified.

en.when: Selecting new narration for a multi-character story.
en.request: Current reproduction advice, not a historical quote: preserve voice quality within actual authorization.
en.problem: Seeds are existing recordings, not generators. Edited lines need a matching source; mixing replacement voices can break consistency.
en.change: Use one main narrator; assign stable voices by character and maintain role/language consistency across versions. Audition one line before per-line caching.
en.principle: System voices (macOS say / System voice) are licensed only for personal non-commercial use: draft auditions, never defaults or delivery. Prefer seeds, then a configured compatible service or Agent Gemini TTS/ElevenLabs, then local neural voices. Qwen/Kokoro require separate direct-edition installation; store has no Qwen. Otherwise use subtitles and licensed music, explain upgrades and never fall back to system voices. See galanty://guide/craft and galanty://environment.
en.cost: Offer available free options first. Cloud services receive narration; estimate cost and obtain consent, reusing existing authorization. An empty budget authorizes no charges; free compilation is not free cloud speech.
en.counterexample: Users can choose another treatment. Do not mix voices silently or treat a system-voice audition as delivery authorization.
en.verification: Current guidance only. Historical tools and costs remain unchanged; no new synthesis or full listening was performed here, and old approval does not approve new lines.
